date.as_written: bhūpañca saptadaśabda śāke māse śuci kṛtithautu pañca asmin nahni ʼrkkadivase

notes: The chronogram 'bhū-pañca-saptadaśa' yields Śaka 1751 (1829 CE). 'śuci' designates the month of Āṣāḍha. 'kṛ' indicates kṛṣṇapakṣa. 'paṭhin' before Dattarāma may represent a title or a corrupt form of the participle 'paṭhan' (reading/studying).
